text:
maria: Quick q — I'm opening a docs PR that only touches examples/ and updates a few external links. Do CODEOWNERS still require approvals from @docs-team or can we fast-track this into the Friday deploy window?

jordan: If it's purely examples and no API surface changes, CODEOWNERS usually only triggers for paths covered by the file. Do you know the exact paths?

maria: 2 files under docs/examples/, plus a link fix in docs/reference/auth.md. CODEOWNERS has a rule for `/docs/ @docs-team` but not for `/docs/examples/` specifically.

sam: Two quick notes: 1) GitHub required-reviewers check will still run and block merge until an approval is present if CODEOWNERS matches any changed path. 2) The docs-preview check (netlify/github-preview) will also run and is sometimes flaky — CI's allowed to be green pre-merge.

alex: If the PR is low-risk we usually ask a single reviewer from docs to ACK. You can ping `@docs-team` or add `r? @jordan` in the PR description. Also, if CI is green and you have the explicit approval, enable auto-merge in GitHub and it should go in the next merge window.

maria: Thanks. What's the exact auto-merge behavior? I thought auto-merge requires all required status checks + reviews. Can org-level enforcement block it?

sam: Correct — auto-merge requires both: (a) all required status checks pass, (b) required approvals are present. Org-level settings like "Dismiss stale reviews" or branch protection can affect things, but we use the repo setting: require 1 approval from CODEOWNERS and specific checks (docs-preview, ci/lint).

ci-bot: `docs-preview` started for PR #4212 — building preview site (this can take ~3-6 min).

jordan: If docs-preview flakes, you can re-run the job with the GH UI or add a comment with `/rebuild docs-preview` (bot will rerun). For Friday deploys we try to get PRs merged before 10am PST to catch the build + manual spot-check.

maria: OK I'll ping `@docs-team` for a quick review and aim to have approvals by Thu EOD. If docs-preview fails with an unrelated netlify timeout, is it OK to override?

alex: Don't override checks unless it's a known infra issue and `eng-infra` already acknowledged it. Otherwise wait for a rerun. If you need a faster path, mark the PR as "cherry-pick for docs deploy" in the body and @sam or @jordan can expedite review.

docs-bot: Reminder: changes to `/docs/reference/` trigger API reference owners in CODEOWNERS.

maria: Noted — the auth.md link is in reference but just a typo fix. I'll call out in the PR that it's a documentation-only, non-behavior change.

sam: That helps. Also add the label `docs:minor` — release scripts use that to include it in the scheduled docs deploy.

maria: Adding `docs:minor` now and pinging @jordan. Thanks everyone. :pray:

jordan: Got it, will review now. :thumbsup:
